notes: Each entry was derived by reading page.tsx + colocated actions.ts and grepping for sendEmail/sendTemplated/stripe./ghl/logAuditEvent/revalidatePath. Trivial pages are still listed.

groups.name: Operations
groups.tagline: Daily run-of-show — what the admin uses on a busy delivery day

pages.purpose: Today-at-a-glance KPI hub: pending payments, bookings today/this week, revenue, route plan, damages, payouts, quotes, inbox.
ui_elements: 4 KPI cards (pending payment / bookings today / bookings this week / revenue this week) with click-through hrefs
Today + Tomorrow route columns with emoji + status badges
Color-coded AlertPanel cards: amber (inbox/pending pmt), red (damages), blue (quotes), purple (loyalty payouts ready)
business_rules: Pending payment list filtered to booking_status='pending_payment'
Today/tomorrow route lookups by route_date
Loyalty payout-ready list reads commission_payout_threshold_cents from site_settings (defaults 5000)
Damage list filtered to resolved=false
Quotes filtered to status IN ('sent','viewed')
notable_patterns: All 11 queries fired via Promise.all for one round-trip
force-dynamic to avoid stale cached counts
Reads tenant timezone via getTenantInfo and formats via formatDateTimeInTz

pages.purpose: Filterable booking list by date range and status — the master event log.
ui_elements: Date range form (from/to defaults: today → today+90d)
Status filter dropdown (all / pending_payment / confirmed / delivered / completed / cancelled)
Table cols: Date (+ multi-day badge), Customer, Product, Amount, PaymentBadge, BookingBadge, View link
business_rules: Default view = events from today forward 90 days
Multi-day events shown with end-date + day count
notable_patterns: Querystring-driven filters (no client state)
Server-side dynamic page

pages.purpose: Full booking command center: event/customer/payment info, delivery checklist, proofs, damages, expenses, internal team chat, inspections, status actions.
ui_elements: BookingInspectionsSection (ERPNext-inspired Quality Inspection, shipped 2026-06-16) with suggested template
DamagesSection with severity, cost_cents, customer_responsible, covered_by_protection toggles
BookingActions footer (status change, mark paid, refund, restore, cancel)

server_actions.name: updateBookingStatus
server_actions.what: Validates with Zod enum, mutates booking_status, on 'cancelled' marks pending pmt as failed + appends audit note + sends sendBookingCancelled + reverses coupon; revalidates /admin/bookings, /admin/bookings/[id], /admin/coupons

server_actions.name: markAsPaidManually
server_actions.what: Sets stripe_payment_status='paid' + booking_status='confirmed' + payment_method (cash/venmo/zelle/check/other); awardForPaidBooking (loyalty) + sendBookingConfirmation; revalidates booking pages

server_actions.name: refundBooking
server_actions.what: Stripe refunds.create if stripe payment; appends audit note; sets stripe_payment_status='refunded' + booking_status='cancelled'; sendBookingRefunded; reverseCouponIfPaid; logAuditEvent('booking.refunded')

server_actions.name: restoreBooking
server_actions.what: Reverses a cancellation — paid bookings → confirmed, others → pending_payment

server_actions.name: updateBookingNotes
server_actions.what: Free-text notes mutation, revalidates detail page

business_rules: Cancellation appends '[YYYY-MM-DD] Cancelled by {email}' to notes
Refund only allowed if stripe_payment_status='paid' and not already refunded
Stripe auto-refund requires isStripeConfigured() + stripe_payment_intent_id; otherwise admin handles manually
Cancelling a paid+coupon booking reverses the coupon use
Restore route depends on prior payment status
Inspections section uses suggestTemplateForBooking heuristic (per-product, per-category fallback)
external_effects: Awards loyalty points + referral commission via awardForPaidBooking
notable_patterns: All non-page data fetched via 2 parallel Promise.all batches
Idempotent email sends wrapped in try/catch and marked non-fatal
revalidatePath includes /admin/coupons because coupon counters change on cancel/refund

pages.purpose: Manual booking creation form for phone/walk-in/offline rentals.
ui_elements: NewBookingForm client component with product picker, customer fields, dates, times, total, payment method, status, notes

server_actions.name: createManualBooking
server_actions.what: Zod-validated form (NewBookingSchema); inserts row with computed stripe_payment_status (none→pending else paid) + 'Created manually by {email}' note; revalidates /admin/bookings

business_rules: payment_method='none' → stripe_payment_status='pending', otherwise 'paid'
Dollars-to-cents conversion (input is integer dollars *100)
external_effects: No emails fired here — admin opts to send manually via detail page (markAsPaidManually triggers confirmation)
notable_patterns: Server action bound at submit, no JS-driven post

pages.purpose: Focused driver-friendly view of just the photo + signature proof capture for delivery or pickup phases.
ui_elements: ProofCapture component reused from booking detail
Back link routes to /driver or /admin/dispatch/route based on referrer query

server_actions.name: proof-actions.ts (capturePhoto, captureSignature)
server_actions.what: Server actions in colocated file for storing proof image + signature data URL on booking_proofs

business_rules: Driver workflow stays inside dispatch chain via ?route param
external_effects: Uploads images to Supabase Storage 'site-assets' bucket
notable_patterns: Mobile-optimized minimal layout for in-the-field use

pages.purpose: Month-grid calendar of all bookings, multi-day events expanded across cells.
ui_elements: 6×7 grid cells with stacked booking chips
business_rules: Grid pads 7 days before/after month to catch multi-day overflow
Multi-day expansion done in JS (one cell per day in span)
notable_patterns: ?month=YYYY-MM URL param for deep linking

pages.purpose: Per-product or all-products view of blocked dates + active bookings for the next 3 months.
ui_elements: AvailabilityOverview (matrix of all active products vs dates)

server_actions.name: blockDate / unblockDate (availability/actions.ts)
server_actions.what: Inserts/deletes rows in blocked_dates for maintenance, damaged unit, or personal hold

business_rules: Window: today → today+3 months
Booking includes pending_payment/confirmed/delivered/completed (excludes cancelled)
notable_patterns: Two distinct UIs in one route based on ?product param presence

pages.purpose: Day-by-day dispatch planning home: next 7 days, booking volume + route count per day, jump to plan tomorrow.
ui_elements: Per-day rows: weekday + bookings count + 'X routes planned' badge
business_rules: Counts confirmed+delivered as 'paid' subset of total
Day labels use tenant timezone (formatDateInTz)
notable_patterns: Requires getCurrentUserRole login — driver lands on /driver instead

pages.purpose: Per-day dispatch planner: create delivery or pickup routes, assign vehicle + trailer + driver + bookings to each.
ui_elements: DispatchClient component for assigning bookings to routes
Driver picker resolved from user_roles.role='driver' joined to auth.users metadata
data_tables: bookings (filtered by event_date for delivery, event_end_date for pickup)

server_actions.name: createRoute
server_actions.what: Zod-validated insert of dispatch_routes row with vehicle/trailer/driver/notes/route_type; revalidates /admin/dispatch/[date]

server_actions.name: assignUnitsToRoute
server_actions.what: Per-unit dispatch assignment via dispatch_route_units — marks prior assignments as 'returned' before inserting new

server_actions.name: markUnitsReturned
server_actions.what: Sets returned_at + return_condition (good/needs_repair/broken) + propagates condition to inventory_units

business_rules: Pickup candidates use OR on (event_end_date == date) OR (event_end_date IS NULL AND event_date == date)
Cancelled bookings excluded
Driver names resolved from auth.users user_metadata (first/last/email)
Returned condition non-'good' also updates inventory_units.condition
notable_patterns: Uses createAdminClient({ unscoped:true }) for auth admin listUsers (bypass tenant proxy)
Two-step bookings fetch (no FK embed for dispatch_stops)

pages.purpose: Single-route driver view: stops in order, customer phone/address, per-stop delivery/pickup status updates.
ui_elements: Route header with vehicle + trailer + driver + date
Load aggregator showing what to put on truck
business_rules: Back href is role-aware: driver → /driver, admin/staff → /admin/dispatch/{date}
Bookings fetched via two-step (PostgREST FK embed unavailable for dispatch_stops)
notable_patterns: Read-once route load via getRouteLoad helper

pages.purpose: Quote pipeline: drafts, sent, viewed, approved, declined, expired, converted — with conversion revenue stat.
ui_elements: 4 summary cards (drafts / sent-awaiting / approved / converted revenue)
Table: quote_number, customer, event, total_cents, status, sent_at
business_rules: All-time stats computed across all rows (separate query)
Latest 200 rows in main table
notable_patterns: Status color map shared with detail page

pages.purpose: Build a new quote: customer + line items + discount + tax + waiver + protection toggles + custom message.
ui_elements: Damage protection / waiver / tax / surface / power supply settings hydrated from site_settings

server_actions.name: createQuote
server_actions.what: Zod-validated, generates token via new_quote_token RPC, tenant-scoped sequential number via next_quote_number RPC (with race-retry); inserts row + computes subtotal/discount/tax/total; defaults expires_at = today+expires_days

business_rules: Number generation retries up to 3x to avoid race condition on MAX+1
Default expires 14 days out (1–90 day range)
Email lowercased + trimmed on insert
external_effects: createQuote doesn't send email automatically; sendQuote action (on detail page actions) sends via renderQuoteEmail + sendTemplated('quote_sent')
notable_patterns: Settings flattened into editorSettings map for client form
buildDefaultQuoteMessage merges tenant brand + site URL

pages.purpose: Quote detail — editable when draft, read-only summary + customer link + lifecycle log when sent/approved/etc.
ui_elements: QuoteActions toolbar (Send / Resend / Copy customer link / Mark as approved/declined)
When non-draft: Customer / Event / Line items / Subtotal-discount-tax-total / Customer message / Internal notes / Lifecycle list

server_actions.name: sendQuote
server_actions.what: Sends quote_sent template via sendTemplated to customer + sets status='sent', sent_at

server_actions.name: approveQuote / declineQuote
server_actions.what: Manual status flips bypassing customer magic link

server_actions.name: convertQuoteToBooking
server_actions.what: Creates bookings row referencing this quote, sets converted_booking_id + status='converted'

business_rules: Drafts editable; sent quotes lock the line items
Tax recompute respects tax_exempt + tax_manual_override flags
Token URL pattern: {NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/quotes/{token}
external_effects: Booking creation on convert triggers downstream booking_confirmation when paid
notable_patterns: Single page handles two modes (edit vs view) by status check

pages.purpose: (Implicit) — editing happens inline on /admin/quotes/[id] when status='draft'. No separate /edit route exists.
business_rules: Note: filesystem has NO /admin/quotes/[id]/edit/ directory — editing is in-place on the detail page
notable_patterns: Convention: route only used when status=draft, same component reused

pages.purpose: Contact-form + inbound-email message triage: read, reply via Resend, mark resolved, internal notes.
pages.audience: admin / staff (if tenants.inbox_enabled=true; else redirected to dashboard)
ui_elements: Per-message: replies thread sorted oldest-first, GHL webhook error flag, email send error flag

server_actions.name: replyToMessage
server_actions.what: Validates body 1–10000 chars; sendEmail via Resend with from=EMAIL_FROM, replyTo=EMAIL_REPLY_TO (Cloudflare worker inbound address) so customer replies land back in inbox; brand resolved from msg.tenant_id; records contact_message_replies row; optionally marks resolved

business_rules: Tenant must have tenants.inbox_enabled=true to use this page
EMAIL_REPLY_TO points at the inbound-mail address (Cloudflare worker forwards to /api/email/inbound)
Reply length capped at 10000 chars
external_effects: Sends customer reply email via Resend with brand from tenant_id
No GHL push from admin reply (already pushed at intake)
notable_patterns: HTML body assembled with paragraph escape + line-break preservation
Customer's original message quoted in <details> footer

pages.purpose: (Implicit) — single-message detail is rendered inline by InboxClient on the list page. No separate detail route exists in filesystem.
ui_elements: Same as /admin/inbox — expandable rows handle detail
business_rules: Filesystem confirms: no app/admin/inbox/[id]/ directory exists
notable_patterns: Single-page inbox pattern (Gmail-like)

groups.name: Catalog

pages.purpose: Master rental inventory: pricing, stock, active toggle, grouped by category.
ui_elements: Per-category table: Name+slug, Price/day, Stock, ProductActiveToggle, Edit/Availability links

server_actions.name: toggleProductActive (products/actions.ts)
server_actions.what: Flips is_active; revalidates /admin/products and public site

business_rules: Grouped by category for UI
notable_patterns: CSV bulk-upload pattern: GET /api/templates/products + POST to bulkUploadProducts action

server_actions.name: createProduct

business_rules: Cents-based pricing
notable_patterns: Trivial wrapper around shared form

pages.purpose: Product editor: image, gallery, details, inventory requirements per surface type / per power supply / per day.
ui_elements: InventoryRequirements panel (per-product gear list with surface gating + only_when_needs_power + per_day flags)

server_actions.name: updateProduct
server_actions.what: Editable fields persisted; bound to product.id

business_rules: Requirements drive delivery checklist on /admin/bookings/[id]
surface_types and only_when_needs_power gate which gear gets recommended per booking
notable_patterns: Sub-action files colocated per concern

pages.purpose: Manage rental categories (Bounce Houses, Tents, Tables...) and setup surfaces (dirt/grass/concrete/paver/asphalt).

notable_patterns: Two unrelated entities on one page

notable_patterns: Items embedded as JSON in packages.items column

pages.purpose: Create a new package.
ui_elements: Shared PackageEditor with products dropdown (active, non-addon)

notable_patterns: Pure wrapper around shared editor

pages.purpose: Edit a package.
business_rules: Items array JSON-typed
notable_patterns: Initial mapped to editor's expected shape

pages.purpose: ERPNext-inspired Quality Inspection templates: pre/post-rental checklists tied to product or category, drivers fill them at delivery/pickup.

server_actions.name: saveInspection
server_actions.what: Records a filled-in inspection on booking_inspections (called from booking detail)

business_rules: Scope precedence: product > category > global
Inspections feature shipped 2026-06-16
notable_patterns: Reused on booking detail via suggestTemplateForBooking

pages.purpose: Create a new inspection template.
ui_elements: TemplateEditor with item list builder, scope picker (product/category)
business_rules: requireStaffOrAdmin guard
notable_patterns: Same TemplateEditor used for edit

pages.purpose: Edit an inspection template.
business_rules: items column is JSON array of checklist items
notable_patterns: notFound() on missing

pages.purpose: Coupon CRUD: percent / fixed-amount / overnight-free discounts, optionally attributed to a referrer for commission tracking.

server_actions.name: findOrCreateCustomerByEmail
server_actions.what: Auto-creates auth.user (email_confirmed) when admin types unknown referrer email

server_actions.name: sendCouponAssignedEmail
server_actions.what: Notifies the referrer that a coupon was assigned to them

business_rules: Code stored uppercased; max 50 chars; regex [A-Z0-9_-]+
Percent type: discount_value 0–100; fixed: stored in cents (raw*100); overnight_free: value=0
Referrer attribution drives loyalty commission flow
external_effects: Creates auth user for new referrer

pages.purpose: Bulk-give-coupons UX: pick customer list + discount params, system generates unique codes + emails each customer.
ui_elements: BulkAssignForm: customer multi-select, discount type/value, expiry

server_actions.name: bulkAssignCoupons (coupons/bulk-assign/actions.ts)
server_actions.what: Generates per-customer unique code prefixed with name/email; inserts coupon rows with referrer_user_id set; loops sendCouponAssignedEmail

business_rules: Unique code generation per recipient
Admin-only guard
notable_patterns: Hero gradient signals 'marketing' UX bucket

pages.purpose: Issue + manage gift cards: code, original/balance, expires, recipient email; aggregate outstanding liability.
ui_elements: 3 stats: Total issued / Outstanding balance / Redeemed
GiftCardsManager (table w/ deactivate, view balance, view code)

server_actions.name: issueGiftCard
server_actions.what: Zod-validated; generate_gift_card_code RPC; insert row; sendTemplated('gift_card_received') with brand-aware from/replyTo

business_rules: Amount in dollars (1–10000) converted to cents
Expiry optional (0–3650 days)
Outstanding only counts active cards
notable_patterns: RPC for code generation ensures uniqueness server-side

groups.name: Inventory & Fleet

pages.purpose: Operational gear catalog (generators, blowers, anchors, supplies). Different from rental Products: gear is what you put ON the truck.

server_actions.name: createItem / updateItem / deleteItem / toggleActive (inventory/actions.ts)
server_actions.what: Standard CRUD; staff can update qty_in_use

tracks_units toggle enables per-unit (serial) tracking
notable_patterns: Category dropdown merges DB categories + orphan strings from items

pages.purpose: Per-item detail: maintenance log, units list, purchase + ROI stats.
ui_elements: 3 stat cards: Condition / Maintenance entries / Total spent
Purchase info card (cost + acquired date + spend% of cost)
business_rules: Unit prefix defaults to acronym of item name
current_route resolved by JOIN on dispatch_route_units WHERE returned_at IS NULL
notable_patterns: Total maintenance spent calculated client-side

pages.purpose: Fleet-wide unit registry (warehouse/loading/on_truck/at_customer/returning/maintenance/retired states) with movement filter.
ui_elements: Filter pills per current_state with counts
UnitsFleetClient (sortable table linking to item detail)

server_actions.name: unit-movement-actions.ts (recordUnitMovement)
server_actions.what: Logs a state transition + maintenance.condition update

business_rules: Inactive units excluded by default
notable_patterns: ERPNext Asset Movement equivalent; shipped 2026-06-16

pages.purpose: Vehicles + trailers used for dispatch routes; per-vehicle compatible inventory item linkage.
ui_elements: FleetManager (vehicles + trailers w/ requires_trailer flag, vin, license_tag, compatible_inventory_item_ids multi-select)
Bulk vehicles / trailers CSV + Export buttons

notable_patterns: Bulk CSV pattern reused

pages.purpose: Server-action backend for all bulk CSV uploads (products, categories, inventory, vehicles, trailers); no UI route.
pages.audience: admin only (CSV upload UIs live on each entity page)

server_actions.name: bulkUploadProducts
server_actions.what: parseCsv → insert products row-by-row w/ slug auto-derivation; tracks inserted/skipped/errors

business_rules: Each action requireAdmin; returns { inserted, skipped, errors[] }
Skipped rows logged with row number + reason
notable_patterns: Single shared toBool/toInt/toFloat/slugify helpers
Per-entity CSV template downloads at /api/templates/{entity}

groups.name: Financial
groups.tagline: Money in, money out — P&L, taxes, 1099s, overhead, Stripe Connect, RentalFlow billing

pages.purpose: Period P&L, tax-collected breakdown, top products/customers/coupons, cash-flow projection, drivers payroll, customer LTV, all-time fleet profitability.
ui_elements: 4 summary cards: Total revenue / Bookings paid / Avg booking value / Unique customers (+ new/returning split)
All-time fleet profitability table per product (cost vs lifetime revenue vs ROI)
business_rules: Counts only paid bookings (stripe_payment_status='paid' AND status<>'cancelled') by event_date
Tax label customizable per tenant
ROI: cost vs sum(total_amount) lifetime
Products with cost=0 sorted last as 'missing cost data'
notable_patterns: Returning customer detected by prior paid bookings before from-date
All math done in JS after a single bookings query

pages.purpose: Year-end IRS 1099-NEC compilation per driver_email; threshold from site_settings, CSV export for filing.
ui_elements: 5 stat cards: Drivers w/ payments / Qualifying / Total paid out / Missing W9 / Filed-of-qualifying

server_actions.name: actions.ts: markAsFiled / saveW9
server_actions.what: Records filing status per driver per year

business_rules: IRS threshold defaults $50 (5000 cents)
Missing W9 flag if driver_email present but no W9 record
external_effects: CSV export served by API route, not server action
notable_patterns: Tax-year config via site_settings

pages.purpose: Hero-style 'report templates' picker (what do you want to know?) — grid of curated question cards.
ui_elements: Template cards (emoji + title + question + description) linking to /admin/reports/custom/{key}
business_rules: Templates defined statically in lib/admin/report-templates.ts
notable_patterns: Minimal UX — questions, not DSL

pages.purpose: Run a single report template with adjustable date range + previous-period delta + CSV export.
ui_elements: InsightChip with delta vs previous period
business_rules: Previous-period auto-derived from selected range length
Templates are tenant-aware via fetchReportRows(tenantId, def)
notable_patterns: Engine separates definition (build) from data (fetchReportRows) from rendering (runReport)

pages.purpose: Fixed monthly overhead (rent, insurance, software, utilities) tracked with effective_from/to for accurate historical P&L allocation.
ui_elements: 3 stats: Active overhead /mo / Annualized /yr / Line items

server_actions.name: createOverhead / updateOverhead / endOverhead (overhead/actions.ts)
server_actions.what: CRUD; 'end' sets effective_to instead of delete to preserve history

business_rules: End-dating preserves historical P&L accuracy
Allocation: monthly_total / bookings_in_month → per-booking overhead
notable_patterns: Time-aware financial model

pages.purpose: Stripe Connect onboarding for tenant: connect/disconnect account, view status, open Stripe Express dashboard.
ui_elements: Explainer ordered list (1–5) of how it works
business_rules: Bookings charge customer cards → funds land in tenant's Stripe → auto-payout 2-day rolling
RentalFlow takes no per-transaction fee — flat monthly subscription

Live Stripe data fetched in parallel
notable_patterns: Founder tier short-circuits to avoid Stripe lookups
